name: Summertime Saga: Realistic Remake
source:
Summertime Saga: Realistic Remake is a photorealistic look a-like Ren’Py visual-novel.
Follow a young man after his father’s funeral as he moves in with a family friend,
begins uncovering the pressure surrounding his father’s debts, and prepares to return to college.
